findings.claim: A cross-question blind route reaches BOTH keys. It is not style-only, so the candidate's declared “style-only floor is 1-in-2 per question” does not bound it, and three independent G-STEM legs (r1, r2, r3) each walked it to picks C and B — the actual key pair — with no passage.
findings.evidence: Reproduced independently on the stems sheet this round. Q1 leg: three of Q2's four options presuppose a contested rank/hierarchy reading (”rangläsningen” A, ”sociala” B, ”hierarkiläsningen” C), which tells a passage-blind solver that the archival finding must be a TENTATIVE status-linked seat pattern; that strips Q1-A (same axis, absolute ”avgjorde”), Q1-B (a records-keeping remark that feeds neither reading) and Q1-D (rotation is the anti-status hypothesis), leaving C alone — and the A/C strength contrast on the shared status–seat axis re-derives C on form alone. Q2 leg: A and C make the same move (reject the rank reading) at different force, so a form-only reader drops both as a mutually redundant pair; of the survivors, D grounds its doubt in ”minnesbilderna” while Q1's stem establishes a DOCUMENTARY base (”genomgång av protokollen”), and that mismatch — created by the very source-vocabulary scrub NOTES §4 performed to satisfy RULE 11 — tips the pair to B. Verdict history: G-STEM r1 flag/flag (picks C, B), r2 flag/flag (picks C, B), r3 flag/flag (picks C, B). Unanimous across three legs, all classed PARTIALLY, none classed ANSWERABLE.
findings.why: Held at note, not major, on four grounds, each checked rather than assumed. (1) Standing bank policy: the batch16 ägardom carried into batches/batch18/BRIEF-ADDENDUM.md rules cross-question stance/axis correlation REPORTABLE AT NOTE SEVERITY and non-blocking, provided the adversarial blind floor is stated explicitly and is no better than 1-in-2 and rule 10 holds. Both provisos verified on bytes this round: the floor is stated (blind_floor_note), and rule 10/13 holds with 2-of-4 hedged in each question (Q1 C ”ofta … verkar ha” + D ”vanligen”; Q2 B ”möjliga/avstår” + D ”antyder/knappast/kan ha”), the key not the sole hedged option in either, and the MOST hedged option a distractor in Q2. (2) Every leg classed PARTIALLY, i.e. materially-better-than-chance narrowing, not decision; the decisive step in each question is an assumption-laden import (that a detail question's locus must lie on the essay's contested axis; that a documentary evidence base excludes a memory-based ground) which a passage could perfectly well falsify. (3) Pure style heuristics really are bounded at 1-in-2 per question and 1-in-4 for the pair: moderation alone gives {C,D} in Q1 and {B,D} in Q2, and “pick the longest” scores 0/2 (longest is B in Q1, D in Q2). (4) Precedent: las-b17-003's V-FINAL held an identical shape (antonym pair + cross-question recycled clause, blind picks matching both keys) at note. Recorded so a future regeneration of this family does not plant the essay's contested axis as BOTH an intra-question strength contrast AND the inter-question corroboration frame.

findings.claim: Attribution seam in Q1: the stem asks what emerged at Tennlöv's review, but the ONLY clause the passage explicitly attributes to her is the one used to KILL option B, while key C's content sits in the next, impersonal sentence.
findings.evidence: Passage ¶2: ”När folklivsforskaren Dagmar Tennlöv 1962 gick igenom protokoll från sju socknar kring sjön … såg hon att ordningen mest kom på tal när den var i gungning: vid tvister, arvskiften, nybyggen. Men där källorna är fylliga nog att pröva saken tycks årplatserna ofta ha fördelats efter gårdarnas mantal – de största hemmanen närmast aktern …” The verb of attribution (”såg hon”) governs only the first sentence; the mantal finding, which is what key C paraphrases, is carried by the impersonal ”tycks” in a new sentence. The Q1 rationale itself treats the first sentence as ”Tennlövs eget resultat” when refuting B, which sharpens the asymmetry.
findings.why: Not a key defect and no rival option is opened by it: the two sentences form one evidential unit (same review, same seven-parish minutes, adversative ”Men” contrasting her two results), ”där källorna är fylliga nog” can only refer to the sources just named, and the stem's ”enligt texten” licenses paragraph-level attribution. Verified that no option becomes defensible under a strict-attribution reading either — under the strictest reading the only explicitly attributed finding (order surfaced mainly in dispute) is stated by NO option, which would leave the item with no answer rather than two, and that reading is not available because it would make the stem unanswerable, so a solver rejects it. Recorded as a genuine seam a strict reader can pick at; a future cut would put ”såg hon också” or ”hennes material visar” on the mantal sentence.

findings.claim: LAW 16 log fidelity: every logged ZERO reproduces exactly and the rejection entry reproduces exactly, but the positive control's Nominatim count in the log does not match what the documented endpoint returns.
findings.evidence: originality_note and NOTES §8 record the control as ”‘Flarken’ -> sv.wiki 56 hits, Nominatim 5 SE places”. My re-run on the same endpoints: sv.wiki exact-phrase ”Flarken” = 56 totalhits (exact match), Nominatim countrycodes=se = 10 results (Luleå, Härjedalen, Boden, Kalix, Vindeln, Norsjö …), which is Nominatim's default page size for the URL form the brief prescribes. Every other logged number reproduced exactly, including the rejection entry “Snesnaren → sv.wiki 3 hits (Stora/Lilla Snesnaren, Lindesbergs kommun), Nominatim 2 real lakes” (I got sv.wiki 3, titles Lilla Snesnaren / Stora Snesnaren / Lista över insjöar i Lindesbergs kommun; Nominatim 2, both Lindesbergs kommun, Örebro län).
findings.why: Info, not a defect: the control's PURPOSE is to prove the endpoint is live and returns non-zero before zeros are trusted, and it does that under either count. The 5-vs-10 discrepancy is most likely a truncated transcription of the result list. Recorded so no later reader treats the log's arithmetic as byte-exact — while noting that the one claim in the log that could have been fabricated cheaply (the rejected candidate) reproduces perfectly, which is the strongest available evidence that the log is honest.

cleared.result: CLEAN — answer C, uniquely defensible, argued against every non-key from the passage alone. C ”Att de största gårdarna ofta verkar ha fått platserna närmast aktern, där saken går att avgöra.” maps clause-for-clause onto ¶2's finding sentence: hedge (”tycks … ofta” → ”ofta verkar ha”), direction (mantal → seat), scope (”där källorna är fylliga nog att pröva saken” → ”där saken går att avgöra”), and content (”de största hemmanen närmast aktern” → ”de största gårdarna … närmast aktern”, with ‘hemman’ apposed to ‘gårdarnas’ in the same clause). A — can the seat CONFER standing? ¶2 says the boat ”blir med den läsningen en flytande spegel av socknens rangordning”: a mirror of an order that already exists (mantal, the church bench), so the arrow runs standing → seat. Reversed and additionally absolute (”avgjorde”). Rejected. B — see the dedicated entry; refuted at three loci. Rejected. D — is any rotation anywhere in the text? The helmsman appears twice: ”en styrman i aktern” and ”Styrmanstoften krävde väderkännedom, inte anor” — a competence requirement, which argues against rotation by farm; and ¶1 states the allocation ”återkom år efter år”, the opposite of ‘ett år i sänder’. Rejected. Exactly one defensible answer. Concurs with four G-KEY legs (C, C, C, C).

CLEAN — answer B, uniquely defensible, argued against every non-key. B ”Han finner både den sociala och den praktiska läsningen möjliga och avstår från att välja mellan dem.” is carried by three separate spans: ¶3's close ”Samma rader kan alltså läsas som etikett eller som sjömanskap; protokollen skiljer inte mellan de två” (both readings possible), ¶4's oscillation ”De veckor jag vill … ser jag rang i varje toft. De veckor jag misstror prydliga mönster ser jag bara balans och armstyrka” (no choice), and the closing admission ”Jag vet ärligt talat inte vad sätena visade.” A — does he END on the technical reading? ¶4 explicitly RE-OPENS both after ¶3 and closes on the admission; ”avfärdar” and ”stannar för” have no textual counterpart. Rejected. C — does he assert the hierarchy reading is a retrospective construction? He calls it a misstanke that ”går inte att lägga undan” and immediately balances it with the opposite misstanke that ”går inte heller att belägga”; ”slår fast” contradicts the whole architecture and ”bör överges” appears nowhere. Rejected. D — see the dedicated entry. Rejected. Exactly one defensible answer. Concurs with four G-KEY legs (B, B, B, B).

CLEAN — and the gates UNDERSTATED the case: the rebuilt B is refuted at THREE loci, not two. B claims the seats were entered in the minutes AT REGULAR INTERVALS and can therefore be followed YEAR BY YEAR. (1) ¶1: ”fördelningen återkom år efter år, så självklar att den SÄLLAN SKREVS NED” — a direct denial of regular entry, and note the causal structure: it was seldom written down BECAUSE it was stable, which forecloses the very inference B draws from stability. (2) ¶2, Tennlöv's own result: the order ”MEST KOM PÅ TAL NÄR DEN VAR I GUNGNING: vid tvister, arvskiften, nybyggen” — conflict-triggered entries are irregular by definition, the precise negation of ”med jämna mellanrum”. (3) ¶2's scope clause ”där källorna är fylliga nog att pröva saken” carries the implicature that they often are NOT, which denies B's second conjunct (”kan följas år för år”) at the level of the source base as a whole. Strongest counsel's case, prosecuted and defeated: the minutes themselves ARE described as a continuous series (”protokoll från sju socknar … förda från 1740-talet till 1860-talet”), and ”sällan” is not ”aldrig”, so could a defender read B as true of the fyllig-source parishes? No: B predicates regular entry of PLATSERNA, not of the minutes, and ‘fylliga nog att PRÖVA saken’ is the evidentiary threshold for testing a pattern, not for reconstructing an annual series — a threshold the passage reaches by aggregating scattered dispute entries, which is exactly what ¶2 says it did. B is dead under every reading.

CLEAN — D is a textbook right-direction/wrong-cause trap and dies on its stated ground. Load-bearing clause: ”eftersom minnesbilderna av vem som rodde var kan ha tillrättalagts i efterhand”. Four independent kills. (1) WRONG EVIDENCE TYPE: the unit's sources are documents throughout — protokoll (¶2, twice), ”såvitt protokollen visar” (¶3), ”Kommunalstämmans protokoll” (¶5). ‘Minnesbilder’ occur nowhere; the essay never interviews anyone or invokes recollection. (2) WRONG OBJECT: the closest hook, ”Misstanken att eftervärlden, jag själv inräknad, läser in mer ordning än roddarna kände av”, is about posterity reading INTERPRETIVE order INTO the record — ‘läser in’, an act of the reader — not about the record or anyone's memory of who sat where being tidied up. (3) DIRECTLY CONTRADICTED ON THE FACTS: the seating facts are asserted as firm — ”Vem som satt var i båten var ingen tillfällighet: varje gård i båtlaget hade sin toft, och fördelningen återkom år efter år”. What is uncertain is what they MEANT, never who sat where. (4) THE PASSAGE STATES THE RIVAL GROUND EXPLICITLY: ”protokollen skiljer inte mellan de två” — underdetermination, not taint. Also weaker but real: ”antyder” understates an author who says outright ”Jag vet ärligt talat inte”. And the stem asks for his HÅLLNING; B states the whole stance, D at best half of it with a fabricated reason, so even a partial-credit reading ranks D behind B.

CLEAN — every repair_log claim verified against the shipping file; no undeclared edit found and no claim unsupported. fleet-repair-3: options[1].text == declared to-text EXACTLY; declared from-text absent from all student-facing fields; planted_traps.1.B relabelled to ‘reversed_inversion (källans karaktär omkastad …)’ as declared; keys ['C','B'] == key_spread ['C','B']; the pre-repair vocabulary (‘overgeneralisation genom scopevidgning’, ‘knapphändiga upplysningar’, ‘scope-widening’) and BOTH rejected drafts named in the ticket (‘sittordningen’, ‘går att följa år för år’) occur ONLY in repair_log bookkeeping, never student-facing — correct append-forward practice, and notably the ticket's account of its own rejected drafts is checkable and checks out. fleet-repair-3b: all three declared rationale fixes present and all three defective strings absent file-wide. Declared post-repair token counts reproduce EXACTLY on an independent count (Q1 A 15 / B 18 / C 16 / D 14, ratio 1.29; Q2 A 13 / B 17 / C 13 / D 19, ratio 1.46), and the claim that the key is the longest option in neither question holds (longest is B in Q1, D in Q2). NOTE on scope of this check: batches/batch18/ is entirely untracked in git, so no pre-repair baseline commit exists; this is a claim-vs-current-bytes verification, not a structural diff against a prior revision. Every claim that is checkable without a baseline is checked and passes.

CLEAN — all eight quoted spans in the two rationales verified. Q1: ”ofta”, ”tycks”, ”så självklar att den sällan skrevs ned”, ”mest kom på tal när den var i gungning: vid tvister, arvskiften, nybyggen” — all four occur VERBATIM in the passage, including the colon and the three-item list. Q2: ”Jag vet ärligt talat inte vad sätena visade” and ”går inte att lägga undan” — both verbatim in ¶4; ”slår fast” and ”bör överges” quote option C's own words, correctly. Zero fabricated quotations. Unquoted paraphrases were checked separately and are faithful: ‘styrmanstoften krävde väderkännedom, inte anor’ and ‘fördelningen återkom år efter år’ both track the passage; the Q1 rationale's rendering of the finding sentence changes the passage's spaced en dash to ‘, med’ but is presented unquoted, so no quotation is misreported.

CLEAN — the declared genuinely-unresolved architecture is real on the bytes, not just asserted in generator_meta. NO SETTLING TURN exists: ¶2's rank conclusion is explicitly conditional (”Båten blir MED DEN LÄSNINGEN en flytande spegel …”); ¶3 opens ”Ändå går fördelningen att förklara utan rang” and closes ”protokollen skiljer inte mellan de två”; ¶4 alternates week by week and closes ”Jag vet ärligt talat inte vad sätena visade”; ¶5 is factual coda. I searched specifically for a covert settle — a late sentence that tips the balance — and found the opposite: the two suspicions are stated as SYMMETRICALLY un-provable (”går inte att lägga undan” / ”går inte heller att belägga”) and ”Kanske gick de två inte att skilja åt” dissolves the dichotomy rather than resolving it. SKEPTIC SLOT: no external challenger exists anywhere; Tennlöv is a source, not an objector; the doubt is first-person (”min egen läsning byter håll”, ”jag själv inräknad”).
